title: In-app help and how-to panel
statement: The system shall provide a slide-out help panel, openable from every web UI view, containing step-by-step how-to guides for each area of the web UI.
rationale: Product owners and new users need guidance on reqforge workflows without leaving the UI.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Help button in the header opens the panel over the current view in 1 click, without changing the route, filters or selection
The panel opens on the section matching the active tab and offers a table of contents linking to every section
The panel contains numbered how-to guides for at least 6 topics: browse and filter, edit and bulk update, chat and changesets, lint and traceability, verification evidence and impact, and projects
A search box in the panel filters sections by keyword and shows a no-results message when nothing matches
Help content is authored as Markdown files versioned in the repository and bundled with the web UI
The panel is keyboard operable: focus moves into it on open, Esc closes it, and focus returns to the Help button
